questions.stem: The current salary is Rs. 60000. To reach Rs. 72000, what percentage increase is required?
questions.explanation:
First find how much extra salary is needed to reach the target.

$$\text{Needed amount}=72000-60000=12000$$

Now compare this extra amount with the current salary.

$$\text{Required increase}=\frac{12000}{60000}\times100=20\\%$$

Therefore the required percentage increase is 20%.

$$\text{Required increase}=20\\%$$

questions.stem: Out of a total of 1000 passengers, 40% belong to adult passengers. If adult passengers grow by 20% and child passengers grow by 12%, what is the revised percentage of adult passengers?
questions.explanation:
At first, 40% of the passengers are adult passengers, so split the original total into adult passengers and child passengers.

$$\text{Initial adult passengers}=1000\times\frac{40}{100}=400,\ \text{Initial child passengers}=600$$

Now increase the number of adult passengers and child passengers by their respective percentages.

$$\text{New adult passengers}=400\times\frac{120}{100}=480,\ \text{New child passengers}=600\times\frac{112}{100}=672$$

Use the new total to find the updated percentage of adult passengers.

$$\text{New adult passengers percent}=\frac{480}{1152}\times100=41.6667\\%$$

Therefore the new percentage of adult passengers is 41.6667%.

$$\text{New adult passengers percent}=41.6667\\%$$

questions.stem: A salary of Rs. 30000 increases by 15%. Find the amount of increase only.
questions.explanation:
Only the increased part is required here, so we need 15% of the original salary.

$$\text{Increase amount}=15\\%\text{ of }Rs. 30000$$

Now take 15% of Rs. 30000.

$$\text{Increase amount}=30000\times\frac{15}{100}=4500$$

Therefore the increase amount is Rs. 4500.

$$\text{Increase amount}=4500$$

questions.stem: After a 25% increase, a route served 25000 passengers. Find the original passenger count.
questions.explanation:
After a 25% rise, the new passengers represents 125% of the original.

$$125\\%\rightarrow25000$$

So divide 25000 by 125 to find the value of 1%.

$$1\\%=\frac{25000}{125}=200$$

Now multiply the value of 1% by 100 to get the original passengers.

$$100\\%=200\times100=20000$$

Therefore the original passengers were 20000.

$$\text{Original passengers}=20000$$

questions.stem: If the income goes up by 15%, find the factor of increase.
questions.explanation:
A 15% increase means the new value becomes 115% of the old value.

$$\text{New percent}=100\\%+15\\%=115\\%$$

Express that new percentage as a multiplier by dividing by 100.

$$\text{Multiplier}=\frac{115}{100}=1.15$$

Therefore the equivalent multiplier is 1.15.

$$\text{Multiplier}=1.15$$

questions.stem: The town had 10000 residents. It grew by 15% and then by 25%. Find the final number of residents.
questions.explanation:
After the first increase of 15%, the residents become 115% of its original value.

$$\text{After first increase}=10000\times\frac{115}{100}=11500$$

Now apply the second increase of 25% to this new value.

$$\text{Final value}=11500\times\frac{125}{100}=14375$$

Therefore the residents after both increases are 14375.

$$\text{Final residents}=14375$$

questions.stem: The crop production was 4000 quintals. It increased by 20%. Find the new production.
questions.explanation:
An increase of 20% makes the crop production equal to 120% of its original value.

$$\text{New percent}=100\\%+20\\%=120\\%$$

So multiply the original crop production by 120/100.

$$\text{New crop production}=4000\times\frac{120}{100}=4800$$

Therefore the new crop production is 4800.

$$\text{New crop production}=4800$$

questions.stem: The current number of users is 10000. If it increases by 10% every year, what will it be after 2 years?
questions.explanation:
Each increase of 10% multiplies the number of users by 110/100.

$$\text{One-period factor}=\frac{110}{100}$$

Since the same increase happens for 2 periods, use this factor 2 times.

$$\text{Overall factor}=\left(\frac{110}{100}\right)^{2}$$

Now multiply the current number of users by the overall factor.

$$\text{Final number of users}=10000\times\left(\frac{110}{100}\right)^{2}=12100$$

Therefore the number of users after 2 periods is 12100.

$$\text{Final number of users}=12100$$

questions.stem: A population increases by 10% and then again by 15%. Find the net percentage increase.
questions.explanation:
Convert the two increases into growth factors.

$$\text{Combined factor}=\frac{110}{100}\times\frac{115}{100}$$

This combined factor tells us how many times the original value becomes after both increases.

$$\text{Combined factor}=\frac{110}{100}\times\frac{115}{100}=1.265$$

So subtract 1 from the combined factor and convert the result into a percentage increase.

$$\text{Net increase}=26.5\\%$$

Therefore the overall percentage increase is 26.5%.

$$\text{Net increase}=26.5\\%$$

questions.stem: The population of Town A was 800 and the population of Town B was 500. They increased by 10% and 25% respectively. Find the difference between the new populations.
questions.explanation:
First find the new value of population of Town A after its increase.

$$\text{New population of Town A}=800\times\frac{110}{100}=880$$

Now find the new value of population of Town B after its increase.

$$\text{New population of Town B}=500\times\frac{125}{100}=625$$

Finally compare these two new values.

$$\text{Difference}=\left|880-625\right|=255$$

Therefore the difference between the new values is 255.

$$\text{Difference}=255$$

questions.stem: To raise a budget from Rs. 40000 to Rs. 50000, what percentage increase is needed?
questions.explanation:
First find how much extra budget is needed to reach the target.

$$\text{Needed amount}=50000-40000=10000$$

Now compare this extra amount with the current budget.

$$\text{Required increase}=\frac{10000}{40000}\times100=25\\%$$

Therefore the required percentage increase is 25%.

$$\text{Required increase}=25\\%$$

questions.stem: A survey covers 400 respondents, of which 40% are online respondents. If online respondents increase by 20% and offline respondents increase by 15%, find the new share of online respondents.
questions.explanation:
At first, 40% of the respondents are online respondents, so split the original total into online respondents and offline respondents.

$$\text{Initial online respondents}=400\times\frac{40}{100}=160,\ \text{Initial offline respondents}=240$$

Now increase the number of online respondents and offline respondents by their respective percentages.

$$\text{New online respondents}=160\times\frac{120}{100}=192,\ \text{New offline respondents}=240\times\frac{115}{100}=276$$

Use the new total to find the updated percentage of online respondents.

$$\text{New online respondents percent}=\frac{192}{468}\times100=41.0256\\%$$

Therefore the new percentage of online respondents is 41.0256%.

$$\text{New online respondents percent}=41.0256\\%$$

questions.stem: After a 10% increase, the salary became Rs. 55000. Find the original salary.
questions.explanation:
After a 10% rise, the new salary represents 110% of the original.

$$110\\%\rightarrowRs. 55000$$

So divide Rs. 55000 by 110 to find the value of 1%.

$$1\\%=\frac{55000}{110}=500$$

Now multiply the value of 1% by 100 to get the original salary.

$$100\\%=500\times100=50000$$

Therefore the original salary was Rs. 50000.

$$\text{Original salary}=50000$$

questions.stem: If a salary rises by 10%, find the multiplying factor.

A 10% increase means the new value becomes 110% of the old value.

$$\text{New percent}=100\\%+10\\%=110\\%$$

Express that new percentage as a multiplier by dividing by 100.

Therefore the equivalent multiplier is 1.1.

$$\text{Multiplier}=1.1$$

questions.stem: A factory produced 4000 units. It increased output by 15% and later by 25%. Find the final output.
questions.explanation:
After the first increase of 15%, the units become 115% of its original value.

$$\text{After first increase}=4000\times\frac{115}{100}=4600$$

Now apply the second increase of 25% to this new value.

$$\text{Final value}=4600\times\frac{125}{100}=5750$$

Therefore the units after both increases are 5750.

$$\text{Final units}=5750$$

questions.stem: The number of internet users was 20000 before the campaign. After the campaign, it increased by 25%. Find the new number of users.
questions.explanation:
An increase of 25% makes the number of internet users equal to 125% of its original value.

$$\text{New percent}=100\\%+25\\%=125\\%$$

So multiply the original number of internet users by 125/100.

$$\text{New number of internet users}=20000\times\frac{125}{100}=25000$$

Therefore the new number of internet users is 25000.

$$\text{New number of internet users}=25000$$

questions.stem: The number of mobile users is 5000 and it grows by 12% every year. Find the number after 2 years.
questions.explanation:
Each increase of 12% multiplies the number of mobile users by 112/100.

$$\text{One-period factor}=\frac{112}{100}$$

Since the same increase happens for 2 periods, use this factor 2 times.

$$\text{Overall factor}=\left(\frac{112}{100}\right)^{2}$$

Now multiply the current number of mobile users by the overall factor.

$$\text{Final number of mobile users}=5000\times\left(\frac{112}{100}\right)^{2}=6272$$

Therefore the number of mobile users after 2 periods is 6272.

$$\text{Final number of mobile users}=6272$$

questions.stem: If the output increases by 20% in one stage and 20% in the next stage, find the net percentage increase.

Convert the two increases into growth factors.

$$\text{Combined factor}=\frac{120}{100}\times\frac{120}{100}$$

$$\text{Combined factor}=\frac{120}{100}\times\frac{120}{100}=1.44$$

So subtract 1 from the combined factor and convert the result into a percentage increase.

$$\text{Net increase}=44\\%$$

Therefore the overall percentage increase is 44%.

$$\text{Net increase}=44\\%$$

questions.stem: salary A is Rs. 50000 and increases by 15%, while salary B is Rs. 25000 and increases by 20%. Find the difference between their new values.
questions.explanation:
First find the new value of salary A after its increase.

$$\text{New salary A}=50000\times\frac{115}{100}=57500$$

Now find the new value of salary B after its increase.

$$\text{New salary B}=25000\times\frac{120}{100}=30000$$

Finally compare these two new values.

$$\text{Difference}=\left|57500-30000\right|=27500$$

Therefore the difference between the new values is Rs. 27500.

$$\text{Difference}=27500$$
